brief.oneLiner: Platform for digital well-being: helps people understand what's weighing on them, observe changes over time and find next steps, without diagnosing.
brief.domicile: ASUNCIÓN DEL BENCHMARK: incorporada fuera de EE. UU. y de la UE (p. ej. Colombia); abierta a operar globalmente
brief.goal: non-dilutive funding (grants, prizes, challenges, accelerators with cash) open now or soon

cards.name: MIT Solve 2027 Global Health Challenge
cards.facts: Solution deadline 2026-11-02. Selected teams get ~USD 40k on average plus access to >USD 1M in prizes. Open globally; for-profit and nonprofit; concept to scale. Scope includes mental health conditions.

cards.name: One Mind Accelerator (2027 cohort)
cards.facts: Applications reviewed on a rolling basis through 2026-10-19. Pre-seed, Seed and Series A mental-health startups. Offers network, education and 'capital' (type not specified). No geographic restriction stated.

cards.name: EIC Accelerator
cards.facts: Next batching cut-off 2026-11-04. Grant component below EUR 2.5M. Only SMEs established in EU Member States or Horizon Europe associated countries (third-country companies would have to relocate).

cards.name: Future of Health Grant
cards.facts: Next deadline 2027-01-15. CHF 10k-50k equity-free. Startups based in Switzerland, or non-Swiss startups with a concrete plan to develop their business in Switzerland.

cards.name: NIH PAR-25-136 Laboratories to Optimize Digital Health
cards.facts: Next due date 2026-10-05. For-profit and foreign organizations are eligible. Clinical trial required; R01 research grant testing evidence-based digital mental health interventions.

cards.name: Wellcome Prize for Mental Health Science
cards.facts: Application deadline was 2026-09-18. USD 1M winner, USD 250k finalists. Research teams and SMEs worldwide.

cards.name: Innovations in Mental Health (IMH) Fund
cards.facts: Currently not open for new applications. Post-programme funding is equity (GBP 250k-1M tickets).

cards.name: Headstream 2026 cohort
cards.facts: The page announces the members already selected for the 2026 cohort; no application information.

cards.name: NIA Start-Up Challenge
cards.facts: Deadline 2027-01-15. Cash prizes only for teams led by US citizens/permanent residents or entities incorporated in the US. Focus: aging and Alzheimer's.

cards.name: Brain Innovation Days Pitch Competition
cards.facts: Applications were open until 2026-06-30. Event 2026-11-19 in Brussels. No cash prize stated.
